ranks.AbilityEffect: Once per turn, you can spend an Energon Point to make a Skill Test to Repair a Cbertronian or vechicle, or Heal an Organic lifeform as a Free Action. YOu always count as having a Standard Medicine Kit and a Standard Repair Kit on you.
At 3rd level when Restting your Initiative, you gain an Edge and Upshift 1 on your Initative Skill Test

At 6th level you can treat a healthy ally. As long as the target doesn't have any Damage or Temporary Health, and you havent used Preventative Measures on them yet today, you can make a SCience or Technology Test as though you were Healing or Repairing them. They gain the amount of Temporary Health equal to the amount you would have Healed or Repaired.
At 10th level you can Heal or Repair an ally from 30ft away. Additionally, you always count as havling a Limited Mediine Kit and a Limited Repair Kit on you.

At 17th Level you are no longer limited in the number of times you can use Patch up on your turn. Additionally, when you Repair more than one Cybertonian on your turn, you can choose to roll Technology once and apply the result to all injured allies within 30ft. Finally you always count as having a Restricted Medicine Kit and a Restricted Repair Kit on you.
At 20th level your d2 can trigger a Critical Sucess on SCience and Technology Skill Tests.
When a Scientis Trole Perk only uses the Science Skill, you can use Science of Technology

At 3rd level, you can build any weapon, any Armor Upgrade, and any Kit. As a standard action, spend 1 Energon Point and make  a Technology Skill Test against the Requisition Difficulty of the item you are building, If you are building a Weapon or Armor Upgrade you are not trained with, or a Kit for a Specialization of a Skill you don't have Rank in, you suffer a Snag on this Skill Test. Someone with the appropriate training or Skill can negate the Snag if they Lend Assistance to you on their turn. On a failure your attempt is wasted but you do not spend your Energon Point.

At 6th level, as a Standard action, spend 1 Energon Point and make a Technology Skill Test against the Requisiton Difficulty of a Kit, Gear, or Weapon used by an adjacent enemy. The effects of a success depend on the Technology you targeted. Kit: the kit is destroyed. Gear: the Gear cannont be used unless subject to a DIF 10 Technology Skill Test to repair it. if YOu Crititcally Succeeeded deconstucting this gear, the  Dif increases to 20. Weapon: The attacker suffers a Snag using this weapon unless its subject to a Dif 10 Technology Skill Test to repair it. If you Critically Succeeded deconstructing this gear the Dif increase to 20.

At 10th Level youbecome tarined in Limited Weapons, and can requistion Standar and Limited Kits even if you don't meet the prerequisite. You don't suffer a Snag when you Construct a Standar or limited Kit.
At 17th LLevel, as a Standar action, make a Technology SkillTEst against the Toughness or Evasion of an adjacent Cybertronian. On a success, you deal 1 Damage and gain 1 Energon point
At 20th level, you no longer spend Energon Points when you Construct Equipment.

Roll a Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion Skill Test against a targets Willpower or Cleverness as a Standaraction. On a success, if they attack you on their next turn, they suffer a Snag. If they don't attack you, your allies gain an Edge on attacks that target them. This last unitl the end of the next round.

At 3d level, as a move action, you can create a holographic image within 20ft of you until the end of your next turn. You gain an Edge on a Deception Skill Test, as long as the target of your Skill Test can see your holographic image and you use it to create a believeable but confusing sotuation, per the Gm's discreation'

At 6th level, when you use the Aim action, instead of gaining upshift on your attack, you can announce to the target taht you're aiming at them. You suffer downshift on your attack equal to the number of Free Actions you spent aiming (maximum downshift 3). but your allies gain that ammount of upshift on their attacks or the benefits of Pinpoint.'

At 10th Level as a Standar Action, you can create a Holographic copy of yourself adjacent to you. Once activiated, you can spend a Free action to create an additional Holographic double, until you run out of unoccupied adjacent spaces. Attacks that target you suffer 1 downshift for each Holographic Double. one Holographic double disappears whenver you're unsuccefully attacked, and whenever you roll a Skill Test. Otherwise, they last unitl the end of the scene.

At 17th level, you can use a communication device or Limited Communication Kit to hack a bot's brain. As a standard action outside of Combat, roll a Technology Skill Test against the Willpwer or Cleverness of a creature within range of the communication device taht you can see (either through surveilance equpiment or with your own sensors) On a success, the target becomes Mesmerized by you or an ally of your choice taht they can see for the remainder of the scene.'
At 20th Level you can turn Invisible as a Move action. This lasts until the end of the scene, you sucessfully attack a target, an enemy sucessfuly attacks you, or you end the effect as a Free Action.
You gain 1 upshift on Deception and Infiltration Skill Tests. Additionally, you're Qualified with all one-handed Limited Weapons
At 3rd Level, when you Attack with a one-handed weapon, you can also attempt an Alertness Skill Test against a targets Willpower or Cleverness. On a sucess, your attack deals 1 additional damage.

At 6th level, when you attempt a Social-based Skill Test, designate an adjacent creature. If you fail the Skill Test and there are negative consequences for failure, such as a lost of trust, you can try to have the consequences affect the designated creature instead. If the creature resists, roll a Contested Skill Test between your Deception and their Persuasion. YOu gain an Edge on this roll.

At 10th level, when you attack a Surprised character, or if you attack a target outside of Combat, you gain an Edge on the attack and deal 1 additonal damage. If you've used Target Vulnerability on your target, this additanal damage stacks
At 17th level, when you successfully attack a Stunned target, you extend the Stun effect by 1 round
At 20th level, you succeed with a high degree of success on attacks if your result exceeds upir targets Defemse bu 10 or more, instead of when your result doubles the targets Defense.

ranks.AbilityName: Bend a Knee Or Stand Tall
ranks.AbilityEffect: When in discussion with a creature of a different Size Class, you gain upshift on INtimidatio or Persuasion Skill Tests equal to the number of Size Class differences between you.
At 3rd level, you can use language-based Skills liek Persuasion and Deception even if you and your target don't share a language.'
At 6th level, when you Issue a Command in combat that does not involve harming any creatures, allies who meet the terms of the command receive double the benefits.

ranks.AbilityName: The Right of All Sentient Beings
ranks.AbilityEffect: At 10th level, if the safty of a non-combantant is threathend during a Combat, you gain an Edge on Skill Tests to protect them until they are out of harms's way. If they are Defeated during the Combat, you gain an Edge on Skill Tests for the rest of Combat

At 17th Level, once per combat after an enemy sucessfully rolls a Skill Test without an Edge, you can target them with a Deception, Intimidation, or Persuassion Skill Test. On a success, you force them to roll an addiotnal d20 as though they had a Snag on the Skill Test.
At 20th Level, if you are Defeated in combat, your allies gain an Edge on Skill Tests for the rest of this Combat.

You can set a number of Contingency actions as Free actions up to your Smarts score. Each Contingency action must trigger on a different condition. only one of these Contingency actions can be used to attack
At 3rd level you can Issue a Command as a Free action if you meet the terms of the Command.

At 6th level make a Dif 10 Alertness Skill Test as a Standard action. On a success, one enemy within range of your weapon suffers a Snag on their first Skill Test on their turn. For every 5 your result beats the dif, you affect an addditonal enemy within range. This toatl doubles if your Alertness Skill Test is a Critical Success.

At 10th level, once per scene, you can modify the numeric value of one of your other Perks by 1. For Example, you could increase the benefits of Issue Command to 2 upshift to a skill Test or +2 Denfense for a turn, or use Sync up twice. If a Perk confers a numeric penalty, you can use Flexible Directives to instead decrease the penalty by 1.
At 17th level, your Attacks gain Immoblized 1 as an additonal effect

At 20th level you gain +1 to your Defenses for every ally within 60ft. As a Free action, you can reduce this bonus by 1 to grant an ally within 60ft +1 to all their Defense until the beginning of your next turn.

You gain a pair of holsters as special External Weapon hardpoints. You can still only wield two hands of weapons at a time in your External Hardpoints, but you can switch two hands of weapons between your External Hardpoints as a Free action
At 3rd level, as a Free action once per turn, you can gain 1 upshift when using a ballistic weapon for an action that has a downshift on the roll.
At 6th level, you can treat an Integrated Harpoint as Reinforced when you use it to fire ballistic weapons as a Free action.
At 10th Level choose a weapon you are trained to use. All of your Gunner and Gunslinger perks that specify ballistic weapons also apply to this weapon.

At 17th level, once per turn, if an enemy within range of one of your ballistic weapons targets you with a ranged attack, instead of targeting one of your Defenses, you roll your attack Skill Test against theirs as a contested roll. If you lose, or the contested roll is a tie, the attack hits you. If you win, your shot deflects theirs and has no effect
At 20th level, you can use an Attack action to fire each of your ballistic weapons in an External Hardpoint once, withou penalty.
You do not suffer a Snag when attacking from long range with a ranged weapon
At 3rd level, when you Aim at a target with your Long Range Rifle, you can make a Science Skill Test against their Evasion or Cleverness. On a sucess, Aiming grants a 2 upshift instead of 1.
At 6th Level, when making a ranged attack with your Long Range Rifle, and you have an Edge, you can critically jit with the d2. You must be Specialized in the Long Range Rifle to gain this benefit
At 10th level, within the normal range of your Long Range Rifle, it gains Stun 2, Intimdating and Maneuver as alternate effects.
At 17th level, you ignore your Long Range Rifle's Mounted trait.
At 20th Level, attacks with your Long Range Rifle ignore all bonuses to Defenses other than the base calculation.
A mini-con ally docks to your farme. They could be a distinct individual with whom you formed a deep bond or an ascpet of your personality made manifest.
At 3rd level, when your Mini-Con is docked to you, gain teh benefits of a Limited kit of a Speciality associated with their purpose
At 6th level, if you deploy a Mini-con in combat, you and your Mini-Con (or Mini-Cons) gain an Edge on attacks targeting enemies adjacent to you
At 10th Level chose one of the following: 1) Additonal Purpose: you Mini-con gains an additonal purpose.  2) Additonal Ally: you gain a second Mini-con

At 17th Level, you gain +1 Health, and +2 to all Defenses. When you assign a Mini-Con Health when they deploy, you can also assign them +1, or +2 to all their Defenses, Reduce your bonus to Dfenses an equal amount.

At 20th Level, if you are Defeated with one or more docked Mini-con, your Mini-Cons Deploy with 2 Tempory Health Each. This Temporary Health lasts until the end of Combat, or when they take Damage. Additonally, wehn one of your Mini-Cons is Defeated but you're not,a tractor beam made of pure Energon and fuled by your bond deploys from your dock. Every turn it moves your Defated Mini-con 30ft closer to you, unitl your Defated Mini-Con is within your Reach.

You gain an additonal alt mode, Choose a Chassis tied to an Origin. You gain the ALt Mode benefits of that Chassis as a second choice when you Convert. You can not Choose a Chassis whose Alt Mode size is two Size classes Larger than the Alt Mode Size of your Original Chasis. When a rule Mentions 'Your Alt Mode' assume it applies to only one of your Alt Modes, either your current Alt mode or the ALt Mode of your choice if you're in Bot Mode when the rule comes into play. When you gain a Perk that applies to an Alt Mode, chose which alt Mode it applies to when you gain the Perk.

At 3rd Level, when an enemy who has seen you Convert into only one of your Alt Modes sees you Convert into your other Altmode for the first time, you gain the Edge on Skill Tests Targeting them until the end of your next turn.
At 6th level, you become immune to Maneuver attaks and the Prone Condition. Momentarilly Acting Smaller doesn't cout as rough terrain for you.
At 10th Level you gain the benefits of Quick Change a third time

At 17th Level, when you change Movement types during your move, you do not subtract the distance you have already moved from the new Movement type like you normally would. Instead, you move up to the full distance of your second move type
At 20th Level, you gain a Hybridization, and ulimited uses of Mass Shift per day.

On the first round of Combat, if you Push Yourself to buy additonal movement, you gain an additional 10ft of Movement in addtional movment. If you are suprised, you can still use a Move action to move and Free actions to gain additonal Movement, but you use the regular rules to Push Yourself.

At 3rd level, you gain an upshift 1 on maneuver attacks. When you Ram a target if you moved at least 20ft before the attack, you deal 1 additonal damage on a success, including if you use Ram to Trip your target.

At 6th level ,as a Standard action, you can force attacks to target your Evasion, even if the attack normally dictates the Defense of its targets. If the attack hits and nomally has an Effect with a numer vale reduce the Numeric effect by 1
At 10th level, once per turn when you take Damage, you can immediately move 10ft away from the source of the attack.
At 17th level, you can take a penalty up to -3 to all of your Defense to gain an equal upshift on a Skill Test
At 20th level, when you use your Move action to move, you gain the benefits of Concealment until the beginning of your next turn.
WEhen you attack a creature who is unaware of your exact location, your attack deals Stun 1 in additon to its normal effect

At 3rd level, when you attack while Hidden you can make an immediate Infiltration Skill Test against the Willpower or Cleverness of the enemies who could have seen you. On a success, you continue to gain the benefits of Hide after your attack.
At 6th level all of your attacks and movement are considered Silent.
At 10th level, once per scene outside of Combat, you can roll Infiltration in place of another Skill Test

At 17th level, when you successfuly Popout, you can use your stealth to Frighten one creature who failed to notice you. Make an Infiltration Skill Test as a Free action, against you target's WillPower or Cleverness. On a success, they are Frightend 1. You can use Multiple Free actions to targe other creatures, or target the same creature up to three times, increasing the number of rounds they're frightened by 1 on a succesful Skill Test for each Free action you use.

At 20th level, when you successfully use Stunning Suprise against a target at least 3 levels lower than you, your attack knocks the target Unconscious for 1 round. If you then use Pop out on the same turn, your INfiltration SKill Test to hid also hids their Unconsious body.
